title: Registry Snapshot
description: The shape of a serialized registry snapshot — what `create-graph-app list --json` prints and what a future AI agent would fetch/parse to query available templates without running the CLI. Each entry is a template.schema.json instance plus its resolved source path; this is a query index, not a second source of truth (the template.yaml files remain authoritative — see tools' parity test in tests/registry.test.ts).

path.description: Path to the template's directory, relative to the package's templates/ root.
